# titer

> An instrument for measuring how often commercial people-search and expertise
> indexes confidently affirm something false, and what it is worth paying to find
> out. Ground truth is an SEC filing or a publisher DOI, not a model's judgement.

Status: published. E1 and E3 measured on verified negatives; two formal
retractions; five of six headline numbers were artefacts of this instrument.
`MEASUREMENT_CARD.json` reads PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and is generated, not written.

Round 7 results: E2 FALSIFIED our own hypothesis D029 - a free-text capability
constraint does disambiguate on an answer engine (C > A in all three colliding
bands, paired intervals excluding zero). A policy is now trained on the R4
simulator and clears the seed gate (0.0461 vs -0.1000, across-seed SD 0.0122 =
0.08x the margin, 6 seeds); it learned selectivity, not calibration. Five
environment defects were found before training, three of them reward hacks, and
the previously published R4 floors were wrong. E4 is not measurable at this
budget when first attempted (D038); the blocker is resolved via OpenAlex
institution lineage and the data is bought, with scoring PRELIMINARY at 203/250
scholar rows: SEC 0.1800 against scholar 0.2069, difference +0.0269
[-0.0464,+0.1014], containing zero (D045). A12's citation audit is COMPLETE at
399/399 for $0: attested affirmations cite a real work by that author 0.5733,
adjacent-false ones about a quarter, and CONTROL ones 0.0000 - zero of
twenty-one (D044). H2 is FALSIFIED and
inverted - false merges are likeliest where names do NOT collide (D041, D042).
Five budgets, still no Ploid accuracy number.

Headline: Exa confirms attested expertise at 0.9600 [0.9279, 0.9781] and affirms
claims about topics the person has never published in at 0.1680 (adjacent
subfield), 0.1320 (adjacent field) and 0.0840 (different domain), n=250 each. It
states 0.987 confidence against 0.889 accuracy. One provider only; nothing here
supports a claim about the category.

## Core

- [CONTRACTS](CONTRACTS.md): frozen definitions. Attestation tiers, the attested
  tuple, closed taxonomies, outcome classes, cost profiles, reward, splits.
- [PRE-REGISTRATION](docs/PRE-REGISTRATION.md) and
  [PRE-REGISTRATION-EXPERTISE](docs/PRE-REGISTRATION-EXPERTISE.md): hypotheses
  with falsification conditions, estimators, and the pre-committed power rule.
  Hash-published before their studies ran, byte-identical since. Never edited;
  superseded only by dated DECISIONS entries.
- [METHOD](docs/METHOD.md): why a filing and not a judge; why cost and not
  accuracy; where a model is allowed to act.
- [ARCHITECTURE](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and seams.
- [DECISIONS](docs/DECISIONS.md): append-only decision log, D001-D045.

## Honesty surface

- [RETRACTIONS](docs/RETRACTIONS.md): two formal retractions. R001 voids the
  entire Ploid arm; R002 voids the raw expertise rates.
- [COVERAGE](docs/COVERAGE.md): what this cannot see, in PeopleSearchBench's
  vocabulary rather than ours. 7.3% of the EDGAR population is usable.
- [RED-TEAM](docs/RED-TEAM.md): 17 attacks on our own claims; 7 carried LIVE,
  2 open, 1 bounded by a control tier. A12's settling experiment is built and
  costs $0, waiting on an OpenAlex quota reset.
- [RUBRIC](docs/RUBRIC.md): independent read 74/90 against a 78/90 self-score,
  with the three downgrades named and not argued with.
- [ETHICS](docs/ETHICS.md): pointers not records; no contact fields ever;
  rectification within 7 days.

## Operations

- [BENCHMARK](docs/BENCHMARK.md): every measured number with its interval.
- [REPRODUCTION](docs/REPRODUCTION.md): commands that run today, and the two
  footguns that silently corrupt results.
- [WAVES](docs/WAVES.md), [HANDOFF](docs/HANDOFF.md), [SURVEY](docs/SURVEY.md),
  [LINEAGE](docs/LINEAGE.md)
